rationale: The Latin anchors *commovere* and *movere* both point to a fundamental sense of physical movement or motion, best matched by stir.v.02 ("move very slightly / shift"). While commovere can carry emotional connotations, the pairing with the neutral *movere* grounds the sense in literal physical motion rather than emotional arousal or stirring of a substance, making stir.v.02 the closest fit among the candidates.
